# vLLM generalized Marlin (vendored)

Weight-only GEMM kernels for quantized weights with 16-bit activations (here: MXFP8 weights,
bfloat16 activations, for GPUs without native FP8 such as A100).

- Source: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm, tag `v0.32.0`, commit
  `5df63a7203cdb9328d824a27b682e77c7b9928be`. License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` in this directory).
- Marlin origin: IST-DASLab/marlin (Elias Frantar), modified by Neural Magic and vLLM contributors.

Files and what SMILE changed:

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `core/scalar_type.hpp`, `core/utils.hpp` | none |
| `quantization/marlin/{marlin.cuh,marlin_dtypes.cuh,marlin_mma.h,dequant.h,marlin_template.h,kernel.h}` | none |
| `moe/marlin_moe_wna16/{kernel.h,marlin_template.h}` | none |
| `quantization/marlin/gptq_marlin_repack.cu` | torch-stable wrapper and op registration removed; plain `launch_gptq_marlin_repack()` added |
| `quantization/marlin/generate_kernels.py` | `QUANT_CONFIGS` trimmed to MXFP8 (FP8 E4M3 weights, E8M0 scales, bf16); output unchanged otherwise |
| `*/sm80_kernel_bfloat16_fe4m3fn_bfloat16.cu`, `*/kernel_selector.h` | generated by the script above with `8.0` |

The host launchers (`marlin_mm` and its helpers) are copied verbatim into
`../../smile_marlin_fp8_launcher.cuh` (dense, from `csrc/quantization/marlin/marlin.cu`) and
`../../smile_marlin_moe_fp8_launcher.cuh` (MoE, from `csrc/moe/marlin_moe_wna16/ops.cu`); only the
`kernel_selector.h` include path differs. The C entry points are in `../../smile_marlin_fp8.cu`
and `../../smile_marlin_moe_fp8.cu`.

To regenerate (needs `jinja2`):

    python3 quantization/marlin/generate_kernels.py 8.0 quantization/marlin
    python3 quantization/marlin/generate_kernels.py 8.0 moe/marlin_moe_wna16

Build note: CUDA >= 12.8 gives template kernel stubs internal linkage by default; the CMake target
passes `-static-global-template-stub=false` because the instantiations and the launcher that takes
their addresses are separate translation units.
